## TRA Timeline

#### Up-C IPO and TRA execution

- 2020-08-24: Initial S-1 filed with form-of TRA (Exchanges) as Exhibit 10.2
- 2020-09-18: IPO closed; executed TRA (Exchanges) filed as Exhibit 10.2 to the 8-K

#### Beneficiary expansions via joinder

- 2021-09-20: Greenspring acquisition closed; Class C Unitholders join the existing TRA (Exchanges) via separately executed joinders
- 2024-05-31: Asset Class Head restructuring closed; Class D Unitholders join the existing TRA (Exchanges) via separately executed joinders

## Explanation

StepStone Group Inc. executed this TRA on September 18, 2020 at the closing of its Up-C IPO, agreeing to pay 85% of the net cash tax savings realized from Section 754 basis step-ups generated by future exchanges of Partnership Units for Class A Common Stock. The contract covers ongoing exchange-driven tax basis benefits and is one of two parallel TRAs executed at the IPO (the other covers pre-IPO Blocker tax attributes). Two later transactions (the September 2021 Greenspring acquisition and the May 2024 Asset Class Head restructuring) added new classes of exchangeable Partnership Units; in both cases the sellers joined the existing TRA via joinders rather than triggering a new contract or an amendment. Aggregate TRA liability across both contracts stood at $313.7 million as of March 31, 2025, with FY2025 cash payments of $9.8 million. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing-by-filing record.
